prompt.generated_prompt_string: Medium full shot of a clearly adult woman with dark hair tied back, seated on a wooden bench, facing the camera with a neutral expression, next to a lean brown horse facing right. She wears a white oversized jacket, white shorts, a dark belt, and light-colored riding boots. Set the scene in a rustic indoor stable with beige plaster walls and wooden ceiling beams, simple wooden stools and bench, soft natural daylight from the side casting gentle shadows, and a warm earthy calm minimalist atmosphere. Include a large woven straw basket on a stool and coiled horse reins on the wall. Use muted natural tones of brown, white, and beige. Retain the elegant serif white J.Crew logo at top center and small white Portugal 2025 text at bottom center as shown in the source visual. Modern rustic fashion editorial, ultra-detailed 4k, controlled 50mm fashion-camera perspective, realistic textures, minimal grain, and no modern HDR look.
